response.overview: Haunted by deep childhood trauma tied to his mother’s past, a man on the verge of marriage finds his unspoken fears threatening his upcoming union. Desperate for a remedy, he and a close friend embark on a chaotic search for a cure through traditional healers, ultimately leading him to a modern psychiatrist. But when the doctor turns out to be a long-lost childhood friend from his painful past, their rekindled connection forces him to confront the exact scars he tried to bury.
response.title: ድንግሉ
